bias.en: Rebound failed · broke $196, SAR turned bearish
bias.zh: 反弹失败 · 跌破 $196，SAR 转为看空

read.en: Coherent fell 12.9% on Nov 20 to $187.22, its lowest close since Nov 5, trading $180.43–209.61 on heavy volume (1.42x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($205.9, falling), 10-day ($215.4, rising), 30-day ($223.6), 100-day ($278.3) and 200-day ($296.5), the last three falling. MACD is above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 20 ($245.73), and RSI is 38.9.
read.zh: Coherent 11月20日下跌 12.9%，收于 $187.22，为 11月5日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $180.43–209.61，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.42 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$205.9，下行）、10 日（$215.4，上行）、30 日（$223.6）、100 日（$278.3）和 200 日均线（$296.5）下方，后三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 11月20日转为看空（$245.73），RSI 为 38.9。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $196–211.5 (5-day, Nov 16 and 18 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $196–197.2, then $200–205.9 (January high, Oct 23 low, 5-day) and $210–215.4 (10-day). Support is $180.4–183.6 (Nov 20 and Dec 29 lows), then $175.2 (Feb 5 low) and $167.5–170.1. A close above $197.2 would target $200–206; below $180.4, $175.
